infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: UniBlueprint needs access to your photo library so you can choose a profile picture or an image for an ad post.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: UniBlueprint needs camera access so you can take a photo to use as your profile picture or ad image.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: UniBlueprint uses your location, only when you tap "Find Near Me", to show Lifestyle partners and coaches near you on the map.
